note: Track notes-on-neck (guitar-scales), step 2: natural notes on the low E and A strings up to fret 12 (note-finder at level beginner), found, named, then every place of one note.

exercise.title: Notes on the low E and A strings, up to fret 12
exercise.why: A barre chord or a scale position is named by the note under it on the low E or the A string, so knowing these two strings up to the 12th fret names every shape you move.

cells.text:
Press Playing it (mic) under the neck below. Then press Start above the neck. The game names a note: find it on the low E or the A string and play it, saying its name out loud.
Keep going until you find the notes past the 5th fret without counting up from the open string.

Press Start in the game below. Now the game lights a note on the neck: press its name under the neck.
Play the note on your guitar as you answer, so your hand learns the place while your eyes learn the name.

Press Start in the game below. The game names a note: tap every place it sits on the two strings, then play those places on your guitar, low to high.
Then make up your own round: pick any note and find it on both strings.
